Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood-inference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Sep 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: HarborHealth discovery — deployment and approval next steps

Emily — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and suggested next steps from our discovery: 

- Key priorities you called out: low-latency patient-facing summaries, audit logging, and private VPC deployment for PHI.
- Proposed pilot: 2-week proof-of-concept on a single care pathway (approx 2 GPU nodes), observability dashboard included.
- Success criteria: <10% latency increase vs baseline for 95th pct, no PHI exfiltration, and verified audit trail.

Action items: 
1) I'll share the SOW and an initial price quote (attached). Please confirm the procurement/contract owner at HarborHealth (name + email).
2) If procurement needs a security questionnaire, we can provide SOC2 docs and our private deployment checklist; cc'ing Ben for security and contract questions.
3) If approval is time-sensitive, suggest a one-page executive summary we can send to the approval committee — flag me if you want that.

Attached: HarborHealth_SOW_v1.pdf, redwood-pricing-quote.xlsx

If I don't hear back in a couple days, Ben will follow up to keep things moving. Would you be able to share who in your org signs off on pilot budgets?

Thanks,
Mina

Hi Emily — quick follow on Ben's note as we head into the end of the quarter. We're closing our Q3 planning and want to confirm whether HarborHealth is still prioritizing the pilot this quarter or if approval is slipping into Q4.

Two quick options from our side to make this easy:
1) If you can confirm pilot funding and approver name by EOD Fri (Oct 1), we can provision a pilot environment and lock in the quoted pricing; we'll also issue a DocuSign envelope for the SOW to speed execution. DocuSign: https://docusign.com/envelopes/0A12B3C4D5
2) If leadership prefers to shift to Q4, say the word and we'll set a targeted kickoff window (first two weeks of Oct) and hold the price for a 30-day grace period.

As noted earlier, our SOC2 summary and VPC/KMS notes are linked: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cHarborHealth

If helpful, I'm happy to schedule a 15-minute call with Sarah + procurement to walk through the approval checklist. Proposed times: Wed 9/30 10am PT or Thu 10/1 11am PT.

Quick one-line reply is totally fine — we just need to know whether to keep the Q3 runway open for you. HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.com/deal/HH-2026-Q3-42
